title: Hearty Garlicky Italian Apples Stracciatella
description: A creamy and garlicky Italian dish featuring braeburn apples and double-fry KFC style chicken, served in a comal, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a comal over medium heat.
Dredge the chicken pieces in the flour, shaking off excess.
Double fry the chicken by first frying at 325 degrees for 5 minutes, then increasing the heat to 375 degrees and frying for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oil and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
In the same comal, add the sliced apples and cook for 3 minutes on each side, or until they start to caramelize.
Add the garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper to the comal and stir to combine.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the shaved Grana padano cheese to the comal and stir until melted and well combined.
Add the cooked chicken back into the comal and stir to combine with the apple and cheese sauce.
Serve the stracciatella hot, garnished with additional grated cheese if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
